messages:
jin: Spotting a new surge of 502s in prod-eu around 23:40 UTC tied to a header parsing edge case. Patch ready (sha: e7c9b1). Can we fast-track? Tonight's 00:30-01:00 UTC window available.

deploybot: Deploy request queued for redwood/api:hotfix-e7c9b1. Default canary: 10% 5m -> 100%. Emergency option: 20% 3m -> 100% if green. Please ACK +1 (owners/oncall).

norah (eng-oncall): +1 for emergency plan. Ran quick staging smoke: ok. I prefer 20% 3m then 100% to reduce flip time.

kyle (sre): +1. I can revert immediately. Two rollback commands below; keep them handy. Also will throttle traffic at LB if needed.

Rollback (image swap):
```bash
kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu && kubectl rollout status deploy/api -n prod-eu
```

Rollback (undo to rev):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=128
```

deploybot: Scheduled deploy 00:31 UTC. Emergency canary started 00:32 UTC at 20% -> monitoring for 3m. Metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=hotfix-canary

jin: +2m into canary: no 5xx spike, p95 stable. KV cache showing normal hit-rate.

norah: Promote at +3m if no signals. I'll hold pager and watch logs.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% at 00:36 UTC... promotion complete. All pods updated. 

kyle: Watching dashboards; all green. No restarts. Throttles unchanged.

norah: Final smoke passed. Drafted release note: "Hotfix e7c9b1: normalize header parsing to stop intermittent 502s (EU)." PR: https://docs.internal/release/e7c9b1

jin: Thanks everyone fast turnaround. If anything pops, use the rollback cmds and ping #eng-oncall.
